title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Is it a sunnah to hold an aasa by imaam at the time of delivering of juma khutba? 5850 views Q. Second Jumah 1853 views Q. Ruling about offering salah after Imam has stood for Jumuah Khutba 3128 views Q. In our palce, after the eid prayers people use to do musafa by telling idd mubarak and hug each other three time shoulder to shoulder. Please clarify whether this system is correct and please inform me that what is the sunnat system of greeting the eid after eid prayers. (2)In our place, after fajr and asar jamath, musalees use to do musafa with imam sahib compulsorily and if a person does not do musafa after the above said jamath prayers with imam sahib some people objects and creates fitna on this issue. Please clarify whether such system is approved in shariat. (3) Please inform me what is the correct procedure for doing musafa with other muslim brother because some people use to do musafa with one hand and some people use to do musafa with two hands. what is the sunnat system 5362 views Q. Here in Saudia Arabia on Jumuah namaz first azan will be given one hour before the azan time 6500 views Q. How many rakath Sunnah are to be offered during Jum'ah salaah.Some say it is two sunnah before fardh and two after.But some say it is 4 sunnate muakkida before and after and 2 sunnate ghair muakkida.Can you please make it clear how many sunnat-e-muakkida and how many ghair muakkida during Jum'ah salaah? 23029 views Q. Jumuah salah 2359 views Q. Bismillahirahmanir-raheem ,As-salamualikum.Respected Mufti Saheb.I have a query regarding the Kutba in Juma Namaz.I Live in Kuwait and a Masjid near my residence delivers the Kutba in Urdu. Several people who i know, but they are no alims, say that a Kutba in Juma Namaz has to be compulsorily in Arabic. When In India I have never heard a kutba in any other language. But here in Kuwait we get to hear in, Urdu, English, Malyalum,Filipino and many more languages. Please clear my doubt and shed some light on this issue. ether its allowed or not. Is the Namaz Complete or otherwise. Awaiting your kind Reply. 2671 views Q. Dear Mufti Sahib Assalam o Alikum! I am a researcher in a university in Pohang (a small city in south Korea). Here we have no local muslim community and masjid. Only few muslim students and scholars are present (from other countries) in the university (about 6 to 8). Some time even more or less because visiting scholars come here for a short time. Out of these muslims only 4 come for jumma prayer including me. My other three muslim friends (those who come for jumma prayer) offer jumma Khutba in English some even they say no word in Arabic except Bismillah. Please tell me if our Jumma prayer is valid under these circumstances or not. Some time there are only three persons for jumma prayer. My friends are of the view that jumma can be offered with three persons also. Please also tell me the minimum nember of persons required for validity of jumma prayer. This university is inside the city Pohang. Is Jumma compulsary here? One thing more I want to know is about the person who can lead jumma prayer. My friends have decided that jumma prayer will be lead by every one turn by turn. All other three friends of mine have no beard. They are very strict in their decision and do not want to even listen any body about it. I have told them that jumma prayer is valid only with Arabic Khutba and atleast with four persons but they are not ready to except it. Please tell me what should I do under these circumstances. Should I offer jumma with them or offer my Zuhar prayer alone. Jazakallah. Looking for an early reply in this regard. Wassalam Aman-ur-Rehman 2242 views Q. If someone is doing that what we must do? 4649 views Q. JUMA PRAYER 29430 views Q. About Fasting on Arafah 8734 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 25878 Country: India Title: Mera sawal ye hai ki Eid ul fitr aur eid ul zuha ki namaz padne ka Correct time kya hai. 2) aur kya namaz masjid me jamat ke sath pad sakte hai ya nahi? Question: Bismillahir rahman nirraheem. Assalam. Mera sawal ye hai ki Eid ul fitr aur eid ul zuha ki namaz padne ka Correct time kya hai. 2) aur kya namaz masjid me jamat ke sath pad sakte hai ya nahi. Jazakallah Answer ID: 25878 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1473/1473/M=1431) (1) Study the book "Din Ki Batain" authored by Hadhrat Maulana Ashraf Ali Thanvi ( رحمة الله عليه ) or ask any local Aalim or Imam. Since its answer requires details for which we do not have time, hence we are sorry. (2) It is sunnah to offer Eid salah in Eidgah . If there is no Eidgah or there is any excuse then you can offer in mosque as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
